load_audio_align_wav2letter: load wav2letter audio alignment data from a tab-separated file into AlignedData objects
cut_align_data: cut aligned audio data into segments at specified word indices with configurable padding
create_AlignedWord: create an AlignedWord NamedTuple with start time, end time, and word text fields
create_AlignedData: create an AlignedData NamedTuple with a file identifier and a list of aligned word segments
summarize_load_audio_align_wav2letter: summarize how load_audio_align_wav2letter parses wav2letter alignment output into structured data
